name: pt-weiterbildung
description: Find training sites for the psychotherapy specialist training in Germany (Psychotherapie-Weiterbildung): search by city and radius, Bundesland, therapy method and application status, see what is new since a date, see how to apply, and get numbers and guides. Data from the lists of all 16 Landespsychotherapeutenkammern, updated daily by pt-weiterbildung.de.
